subject: Film & Cinema
title: Explosion Sounds: Louder Than Reality
description: One-minute skill: Explosion Sounds: Louder Than Reality.

hook.text: Real explosions sound nothing like movie explosions. Hollywood made them bigger.

buildup.text: Film explosions layer multiple sounds — bass rumble, glass shatter, debris, and flame roar.

discovery.text: In space, explosions are silent. Star Wars ignores this because silence feels anticlimactic.

twist.text: Gravity used real silence in space and won the Oscar for Sound Editing for it.

climax.text: Film sound constantly chooses emotional truth over physical accuracy.

quiz.question: Why do movie explosions sound different from real ones?
options: Filmmakers layer sounds to create a more dramatic emotional effect
